svg.text: EOX HOME / FRONT BATTERY / MODULAR SHEET KITS
One 56 × 34 in sheet per functional layer • baseline 0.119 in mild steel / premium 0.125 in 304 stainless
Packaging and material study. Provisional blanks, no joint holes; no structural validation or released order files.

3 layer sheets • steel parts 66.6 kg mild / 70.7 kg 304
73 provisional blanks / 45 bends; hardware and purchased parts additional

Wheelbase 1450 mm • frame 1750 mm • front 45 kg battery

* Deck and wagon have independent sheet budgets; neither is designed in this comparison. Same battery capacity in every concept.
Nests prove only this provisional inventory. Joint design, steering sweep, strength, body clearances and supplier acceptance remain open.
Hybrid: reserve service/cooling/exhaust space, fuel mass and BMS controls; no onboard running approval or runtime claim is implied.
